name: Itsugaya Kanade
source:
Along with [url=/c40163]Hayane[/url], she has known [url=/c47238]Souji[/url] since they were very young and has been getting along with him until he and his sister [url=/c55364]Mayuri[/url] have moved away. Then one day, with their reunion as the trigger, her feelings of love she has been keeping warm have started acting up.

Because of her older sister giving her lots of trouble, she has become meddlesome and caring towards everyone. Although she often goes "good grief" at people, she doesn't feel displeasure towards helping anyone. Her day starts with waking up her sister.

Souji is her first love, but she's aware that his first love is her older sister.

Because she's scared of shampoo getting into her eyes when she's washing her hair, she still can't stop using a shampoo hat.
